title: ThemeBox native session groups — model and retained-path host regressions
head: 189054633f7fb813ac3b03f7110f482ecaad9ffe

scope.environment: macOS Foundation host test executables; compiler scripts use temporary build directories
scope.coverage: New immutable native-array model plus all 13 group shell suites, retained proxy lifetime probe, and related session/alert/privacy/runtime regressions.
limitations: UIKit rendering and WeChat runtime behavior are represented by explicit host doubles. A passing host suite does not establish device compatibility or native animation behavior.

Legacy projection fixtures intentionally use usesNativeSessionModel=NO to cover retained folded/legacy ownership. New main-list behavior is covered by native model and separately maintained coordinator/adapter suites.
This report does not aggregate coordinator/adapter tests owned by the other implementation worker or claim a device acceptance run.
Source hashes identify the report-time working tree, which contains uncommitted and unrelated work. Individual admission suites also print the exact production method/source digests they compiled.

fixture_adaptations: Added native-mode state declarations so unchanged complete production methods compile in existing fixtures.
Added a coordinator identity host double shared by retained projection fixtures; refreshFromPreferences asserts if a legacy fixture accidentally enters the new native path.
Viewport owns minimal row/projection doubles, so its coordinator fixture uses only a forward declaration of the native model.
Business extractor includes the complete production nativePath method required by displayPath.
Folded-session extractor locates its enabled/chrome conditions inside the retained refresh method, avoiding accidental capture of the earlier native refresh method.

Selection adds one native-coordinate bypass assertion. Alerts adds two full-source assertions, and tab badges adds seven assertions rejecting selected-only statistics and unavailable full-source ownership.
All existing behavior assertions remain in place; fixture fixes address compilation after ownership references were added.
Lifecycle adds an explicit test-only native-owner toggle for four production suspension-transition assertions; retained publication fixtures continue to default to the legacy owner.
